altText: An American Goldfinch in summer: brilliant lemon yellow with a black cap and black wings, perched on goldenrod.
A bright yellow American Goldfinch clinging sideways to a dried seed head.
The same kind of bird in winter: a drab olive-buff American Goldfinch on grass seed heads, with the black wings and white wing bars it keeps all year.
A dull olive American Goldfinch in winter plumage clinging to an upright stem.
